metadata.title: Infrastructure reliability incident investigation
metadata.artifact_scope_note: Evidence is aggregated query output (not raw log lines or metric samples); it contains no chat/communication records.

incident_description: Reliability incident investigation of a production environment. Evidence consists of Elasticsearch aggregation results over application and proxy logs, Kubernetes, cloud-provider and host system events, Prometheus Alertmanager alerts, change-management / CI-CD audit records and metric anomaly detection. No root cause, impact or trigger is stated; these must be established from the supplied artifacts. Environment context: Organization: Blueus Journeys (travel booking); Platform: Microsoft Azure southeastasia (zones southeastasia-1/southeastasia-2/southeastasia-3); network range 10.131.0.0/16; Kubernetes cluster blueus-prod-southe (AKS); Billing: a daily charge job 'premium-collection' is triggered by the in-house scheduler 'chronos-lite', which computes run times from local wall-clock time (Australia/Sydney); charges go through payment-gw to an external card processor; job executions are recorded by job name; Change management: production changes carry RFC- identifiers.
investigation_questions: What change, deployment or automation run triggered the incident? Provide its change identifier.
Which job execution was the legitimate run?
What scheduling condition caused the job to run twice for the same local billing date?
During what hour did the first signs of the failure appear? Provide the earliest date and time in YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM UTC format.

What is the root cause category of the incident: configuration change, software defect, hardware failure, cloud provider failure, capacity exhaustion, automation error, certificate expiry, or third-party dependency failure?
Which of the three CIA components is primarily affected: availability, integrity, or confidentiality?
According to the error volume statistics, what single service emitted the most errors? Is it the root cause or a downstream symptom?
